notes: Reading t016 *he* as the supplied subject of ἐπείνασεν and t019 *he* as the emphatic αὐτός is what the ASV's word order (*when he was hungry, he and they*) decides; the reverse remains the competing analysis.
s003 πρός is unrepresented because the ASV writes *them* as a bare object with no English preposition anywhere, which is rule 36's narrow licence.
